description: VicRoads Declared Roads is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. Declared roads are classified under the Road Management Act 2004 as Freeways, Arterial Roads and Non-Arterial State Roads. About 15% of Victorian roads are declared roads and the remaining 85% are local roads About this dataset - Contact us. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are Declared Roads, Road Assets Open Data, Road Network, Road Networks Open Data, VicRoads. It offers 5 resource(s) in ESRI REST, GEOJSON, HTML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
